routine_evidence.note: The animation updater reads duration and flags, advances by 16 bytes, and follows a long backward pointer when flags are negative. The flags word at offset +2 splits into flip_x (bit 15), a 7-bit sequence index, and an 8-bit parameter byte. The tail is not an X/Y word pair: bytes +8 and +9 index interaction tables.

remaining_gate: Map packed assembly source words and offset-table entries to CPS object commands, then prove one rendered pose pixel for pixel against a captured pose; label tail fields and actor-local hitboxes.
